description: Original feasibility rules plus configurable BsaI/BsmBI internal-site exclusion, CleanCap AG transcript start, and exact inverted-repeat risk screening.

provenance.settings: Global 40-60%; local 30-70% in 50 nt. This preset uses stride 1.
Reject A/T runs >=10 and G/C runs >=6; RNA U corresponds to template T.
Avoid repeats longer than 20 bp. Nonoverlapping exact 21-mer copies are this preset's operational definition.
Primitive tandem period 2-6 nt, at least 18 nt and 3 complete copies; requires sensitivity analysis.
No internal BsaI GGTCTC or BsmBI CGTCTC sites in either orientation. This is a selected assembly strategy, not a universal blacklist.
Transcribed positions +1/+2 must be AG. Check only scopes starting at transcript nucleotide +1; the T7 promoter is outside the RNA scope.

Exact nonoverlapping 20-nt reverse-complement arms in a total span <=200 nt (gap 0-160). Zero gap includes >=40-nt reverse-complement palindromes. This is a motif risk heuristic, not RNA folding or a validated universal synthesis limit.
